name: glassvein-codex
description: Codex bridge for GlassVein session capture and prompt context injection.

interface.shortDescription: Capture Codex session state and inject GlassVein context.
interface.longDescription: GlassVein Codex records Codex prompt/stop lifecycle metadata, can publish session_update events to a local GlassVein router, and injects bounded GlassVein context through Codex hooks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use GlassVein context for this Codex session.
